 Collect and Battle with Mega Evolution—Delta Reign in Pokémon TCG Live
 Get ready for some exciting new cards.
 Nov 5, 2026 
 The latest Pokémon Trading Card Game expansion, Mega Evolution—Delta Reign , becomes available in Pokémon Trading Card Game Live on Thursday, November 5, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. PST! You’ll be able to play with the atmospheric power of Mega Rayquaza ex, the cunning Mega Malamar ex, and other powerful Mega Evolution Pokémon ex before you shuffle the cards up in person. Players can also look forward to a new log-in gift and some fun Trainer Trials coming to the game during November and December.
 This expansion’s Battle Pass features two Mega Evolution Pokémon ex on its title card: Mega Rayquaza ex and Mega Malamar ex. Both decks starring these Pokémon also feature powerful new cards certain to shake up your next strategy, so be sure to check out our Mega Evolution—Delta Reign Battle Pass strategy to get the lowdown. You can also visit Pokémon TCG Live’s Learning Lab for hands-on lessons to learn how to wield these complete decks! Remember, the Pokémon TCG Live Battle Pass is available at no monetary cost , so feel free to dive in.
 Log-In Gift & Trainer Trials
 When you log in to Pokémon TCG Live before December 17, you’ll be presented with a special deck accessory set featuring a coin, deck box, and card sleeves, inspired by Mega Evolution—Delta Reign . They’ll be the perfect accessories for your new Battle Pass decks. You’ll also receive 1,000 Trainer Points and 500 Trade Credits to keep building your collection.
 If you’re looking for another way to battle as you enjoy the expansion, you can check out the upcoming Trainer Trials to experiment outside the Pokémon TCG’s traditional Standard format.
 Champion’s Training Ground: November 5–19, 2026 Standard format matches not including Mega Evolution—Delta Reign , for those who need to practice before the expansion is legal for competitive play.
 Colorless Clash: November 19 – December 3, 2026 Standard format matches where every Pokémon in your deck must be Colorless type.
 Darkness Duel: December 3–17, 2026 Standard format matches where every Pokémon in your deck must be Darkness type.
 A New Inbox Feature and Private Expanded Battles
 Pokémon TCG Live is introducing a new, robust Inbox feature to enhance the delivery of information to players. This additional functionality will allow you to stay better informed of new changes and important notifications, and easily find the updates and content that matters most to you. In this first phase, Pokémon TCG Live will also support message sending for friend requests and match invites!
 Alongside this new feature, you can also send private battle requests in the Expanded format. Expanded battles were previously limited to online matchmaking, but you can now challenge your friends whenever you’d like. Please note that Pokémon TCG Live currently supports a limited Expanded format that allows cards starting from Sun & Moon .
 Good luck in your battles, Trainers!
